name: ambience_city_night
prompt: Continuous night-time ambience of a quiet residential side street in New York City at midnight, heard from the sidewalk. A low, steady wash of distant traffic from an avenue several blocks away, the faint drone of rooftop air-conditioning units, light air moving between brick buildings. Even and uneventful: no close cars, no horns, no sirens, no voices, no footsteps, no birds, no insects, no music. Seamless loop.

name: ambience_shop_hum
prompt: Steady electrical hum of a glass-door drinks refrigerator inside a small convenience store, close perspective: a constant 60-cycle compressor drone with a soft condenser-fan whirr and a faint fluorescent tube buzz. Perfectly continuous, no compressor clicks, no door, no beeps, no voices, no music. Seamless loop.

name: subway_rumble
prompt: A subway train passing underground, heard from the street above through a steel sidewalk ventilation grate. A deep sub-bass rumble swells slowly from silence, wheels thud rhythmically over rail joints, the grate bars rattle faintly at the loudest point, then the rumble fades away down the tunnel to silence. Muffled, from below. No brake squeal close-up, no station announcement, no voices, no street traffic.

name: distant_siren
prompt: A single emergency-vehicle wail siren very far away across a city at night, many blocks off, echoing between tall buildings. It swells slightly, passes in the distance and recedes, the pitch drifting a little lower as it goes. Muffled by distance with a long soft echo. No close traffic, no horn, no voices, no music.

name: car_pass
prompt: One sedan driving past on a dry city street at about thirty miles per hour, heard from the sidewalk a few metres away: tyre hiss and low engine hum approaching, a soft whoosh of air as it passes, then receding into the distance. One car only, steady speed, no horn, no braking, no gear change, no radio, no voices.

name: trash_can_crash
prompt: A galvanised steel trash can knocked over in a narrow brick alley at night: one sudden loud metallic crash as it hits the concrete, the lid clattering off and wobbling to a stop, the can rolling a short way. Sharp, startling, with a short hard alley echo. No voices, no animals, no glass, no music.

name: cat_yowl
prompt: A startled alley cat gives one sharp, raspy yowl-screech with a spit of hiss as it bolts away. Sudden, short, angry, slightly echoing off brick walls. A single cat and a single cry: no other animals, no purring, no crash, no voices, no music.

name: door_buzz_open
prompt: An apartment-building front door being buzzed open, heard from the doorstep: a harsh electric door-strike buzzer sounds for about one second, then the metal latch clacks free as the door is pushed. Close and dry. No intercom speech, no keys, no footsteps, no voices, no music.

name: door_close_heavy
prompt: A heavy steel-framed apartment-building front door swinging shut behind someone and latching, heard from just inside a small tiled vestibule: one deep solid thud, the lock bolt clicking home, a short dull interior reverb. One close only. No keys, no footsteps, no voices, no music.

name: keys_jingle
prompt: A small bunch of house keys on a steel ring pulled out of a coat pocket and gripped tight in a fist, extreme close-up: two or three brief bright metallic jingles and clinks, then stillness. Dry, no lock, no door, no footsteps, no voices, no music.

name: gasp
prompt: A young woman's sudden sharp gasp of fright: one quick involuntary intake of breath through the open mouth, cut off short as she holds it. Close microphone, dry, intimate. Female. No scream, no words, no exhale afterwards, no music.

name: breath_shaky
prompt: A frightened young woman breathing fast and shakily through her mouth, very close microphone: trembling, uneven inhales and exhales at about forty breaths a minute, as if trying to stay quiet and not show it. Female, dry, intimate. No words, no whimpering, no crying, no sobbing, no swallowing, no music. Seamless loop.

name: exhale_relief
prompt: A young woman lets out one long, slow, slightly shaky exhale of relief through her mouth, as if she had been holding her breath, trailing off to silence. Very close microphone, dry, intimate. Female. No words, no laugh, no sob, no inhale before it, no music.

name: cloth_rustle
prompt: A brief soft rustle of a cotton jacket sleeve and a canvas tote-bag strap shifting on a shoulder as someone tightens their grip. Close-up, dry, subtle, under a second. No zipper, no velcro, no paper, no footsteps, no voices.

name: phone_camera_start
prompt: A smartphone video-recording start tone: one clean, short, soft two-note electronic blip, the second note higher. Dry, isolated interface sound. No shutter click, no vibration buzz, no voice, no music.

name: shop_bell
prompt: A small brass bell on a coiled spring above a corner-shop door, set jingling as the door is pushed open: a bright ding-a-ling of four or five quick rings that settle to silence. Close, dry. No door creak, no electronic chime, no footsteps, no voices, no music.

name: tinnitus
prompt: A single thin, pure, high-pitched ringing tone like ears ringing after a shock (tinnitus), around four kilohertz. It rises quickly out of silence, holds for a moment, then fades slowly and smoothly to complete silence. A clean sine-like tone only: no noise, no rumble, no impact, no heartbeat, no music.

name: impact_thud
prompt: One dull, heavy, muffled body-impact thud, like a shoulder driven into a padded wall: low, short and dead, with no ring, no crack and no debris. Close and dry. No grunt, no voice, no cloth, no music.

name: wind_gust
prompt: A single gust of cold night wind funnelling down a city street between tall buildings: it rises out of near silence, blows hard for about two seconds with a faint low whistle, then dies away. Wind only: no leaves, no rain, no flapping, no chimes, no traffic, no voices.
